items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: Terminal-style outlined button: bracket convention, focus inversion, no hover/radius/shadow. Variants: default, primary, destructive, ghost.

items.name: breadcrumb
items.title: Breadcrumb
items.description: Terminal-style breadcrumb with focus-first links, muted route separators and current-page highlight.

items.name: pagination
items.title: Pagination
items.description: Terminal-style pagination that reuses the Button visual language for numbered pages and previous/next controls.

items.name: avatar
items.title: Avatar
items.description: Terminal-style avatar with sharp border, Catppuccin fallback surface and initials-first fallback state.

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: Terminal-style text input: solid border, focus ring inversion, no hover/radius/shadow.

items.name: textarea
items.title: Textarea
items.description: Terminal-style multiline input matching the Input aesthetic.

items.name: input-group
items.title: Input Group
items.description: Composable input group with addons, buttons and text. Terminal aesthetic.

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: Terminal-style modal dialog: box border, background-level elevation (no shadow), bracket close [x], discrete opacity fade only. No radius/hover/scale.

items.name: sheet
items.title: Sheet
items.description: Terminal-style side panel built on Radix Dialog: border-defined depth, global slide-in/slide-out keyframes, bracket close [x], no radius/shadow.

items.name: drawer
items.title: Drawer
items.description: Terminal-style bottom drawer built on Vaul: border-top structure, subtle slide from bottom, no radius/shadow, focus-first interactions.

items.name: sidebar
items.title: Sidebar
items.description: Terminal-style responsive sidebar with desktop collapse modes and mobile fallback through Sheet. Includes provider, trigger, rail, groups and menu composition.

items.name: alert
items.title: Alert
items.description: Terminal-style callout: box-drawing border, semantic variants, optional lucide icon. Variants: default, info, success, warning, destructive.

items.name: alert-dialog
items.title: Alert Dialog
items.description: Terminal-style confirmation modal built on Radix Dialog: box-drawing border, discrete opacity fade, no hover/radius/shadow. Reuses button variants for actions.

items.name: progress
items.title: Progress
items.description: Terminal-style linear progress bar: bordered track, Catppuccin fill, sharp corners, restrained 150ms fill updates.

items.name: skeleton
items.title: Skeleton
items.description: Passive loading placeholder using Tailwind animate-pulse with terminal background levels and sharp edges.

items.name: aspect-ratio
items.title: Aspect Ratio
items.description: Sharp-corner media container that preserves image and video proportions with terminal-style border and background levels.

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: Terminal-style status badge: outlined semantic variants with optional [square] or (paren) bracket conventions. No hover/radius/shadow.

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: Terminal-style container with box-drawing border and background-level elevation. Composable header, title, description, content and footer. No radius/shadow.

items.name: separator
items.title: Separator
items.description: Box-drawing divider built on Radix Separator. Horizontal/vertical, 1px border-color rule. No radius/shadow.

items.name: accordion
items.title: Accordion
items.description: Directory-tree style collapsible built on Radix Accordion: ▸/▾ glyph indicators, border-l indent guide, focus inversion. No chevron rotation, no height animation, no hover/radius/shadow.

items.name: popover
items.title: Popover
items.description: Terminal-style floating container built on Radix Popover: box border, elevated --popover background level (no shadow), discrete opacity fade. Base for Select and Combobox.

items.name: command
items.title: Command
items.description: fzf/Telescope-style command menu built on cmdk: '>' prompt glyph, keyboard navigation, selection inversion, no hover/radius/shadow.

items.name: combobox
items.title: Combobox
items.description: Searchable picker composed from Popover + Command + Button. Floating container, fuzzy filter, Vim-style selection inversion, ✓ for selected.

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: Menu-picker select built on Popover + Command (no search input). Reuses the floating container, arrow-key navigation and inversion. Trigger uses ▾ glyph.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: Terminal-style floating hint built on Radix Tooltip: box border, prompt-glyph prefix, discrete opacity fade. No radius/shadow/slide.

items.name: toast
items.title: Toast
items.description: Terminal-style notification built on Radix Toast: box-drawing border, semantic variants, bracket close [x], discrete opacity fade. Variants: default, info, success, warning, destructive.

items.name: sonner
items.title: Sonner
items.description: Terminal-style toaster wrapping the Sonner library: monospace, box border, no radius/shadow, semantic success/error/warning/info colors.

items.name: dropdown-menu
items.title: Dropdown Menu
items.description: Terminal-style dropdown menu: selection inversion, ✓/● indicators, ▸ submenu glyph, no hover/radius/shadow. Includes checkbox, radio, sub-menu, shortcut, separator.

items.name: context-menu
items.title: Context Menu
items.description: Terminal-style right-click context menu: selection inversion, ✓/● indicators, ▸ submenu glyph, no hover/radius/shadow. Includes checkbox, radio, sub-menu, shortcut, separator.

items.name: menubar
items.title: Menubar
items.description: Terminal-style application menubar: border-b strip, open-state inversion on triggers, ✓/● indicators, ▸ submenu glyph, no hover/radius/shadow. Includes checkbox, radio, sub-menu, shortcut, separator.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: Vim/tmux-style tab bar built on Radix Tabs: border strip, active-state inversion, sharp edges and monospace content. No hover/radius/shadow.

items.name: navigation-menu
items.title: Navigation Menu
items.description: Terminal-style structured header navigation built on Radix Navigation Menu: floating link panels, focus/open inversion, viewport fade only. No hover/radius/shadow/slide.

items.name: collapsible
items.title: Collapsible
items.description: Terminal-style collapsible text container built on Radix Collapsible: ▸/▾ state glyph, sharp border, muted detail surface and fade-only content reveal.
files.name: slider
files.title: Slider
files.description: Terminal-style value slider: boxed track, primary active range, sharp thumb and focus-visible ring. Supports single or range values.

files.name: switch
files.title: Switch
files.description: Sharp iOS-inspired on/off switch: primary checked state, boxed thumb, no hover/radius/shadow, keyboard-first focus-visible feedback.

files.name: toggle
files.title: Toggle
files.description: Binary pressed-state control with terminal inversion and primary active state. Variants: default, outline. Sizes: sm, default, lg.

files.name: toggle-group
files.title: Toggle Group
files.description: Single or multiple selection group composed from Toggle primitives with shared size/variant styling and keyboard roving focus.

files.name: resizable
files.title: Resizable
files.description: Terminal-style resizable panels built on react-resizable-panels: subtle divider lines, keyboard focus ring, optional ASCII grip handle. No hover/radius/shadow.

files.name: scroll-area
files.title: Scroll Area
files.description: Terminal-style custom scroll area built on Radix Scroll Area: consistent cross-platform scrollbar, muted track, subtle border thumb. No hover/radius/shadow.
